details.description: Indulge in the authentic flavours of Kolkata with JoySpoon's Calcutta Paan Mukhwas. This delightful treat combines the cooling properties of betel leaves with a premium blend of natural ingredients that aid digestion and rejuvenate the body. Crafted with a sugar-free traditional recipe, this preservative-free mouth freshener is a powerhouse of antioxidants that helps restore normal pH levels and clear free radicals. The addition of saunf and kharek stimulates the secretion of digestive juices, improving gut health, while the cooling and soothing gulkand fights acidity, constipation, and other digestive disorders. Beyond its delectable taste, this mukhwas offers a range of benefits, from preventing premature skin aging to providing relief from menstrual symptoms such as painful cramps, excessive bleeding, and white discharge. Indulge in this authentic Kolkata paan experience and treat your senses to a truly unique and refreshing delight.
